links.comparator_used: Guideline-only RAG (guideline retrieval) and Zero-shot LLM (no retrieval)
links.outcome: Composite expert rating (accuracy, safety, clinical competence, intent capture, helpfulness; Likert 1–5, max 25)
links.effect: Hybrid KG-RAG median composite 23.83 vs 21.50 (Guideline-only RAG) vs 12.50 (Zero-shot); Friedman χ²(2) = 22.13, p < 0.001; Kendall's W = 0.55; top-ranked on 15 of 20 questions; significantly outperformed Zero-shot LLM on all five dimensions (paired effect size r = 0.57–0.81)
links.tradeoff: Three distinct failure modes were identified, delineating the scope and limitations of KG-anchored retrieval.
links.quote: Hybrid KG-RAG achieved the highest median composite score (23.83 vs. 21.50 vs. 12.50 out of 25; Friedman χ²(2) = 22.13, p < 0.001; Kendall's W = 0.55) and was top-ranked on 15 of 20 questions.
